about: Grades for docs/research/fund-infra/architecture-comparison.md. 2 = strong, 1 = partial, 0 = weak, null = not applicable or not verified. Grades are judgments from state-of-art.md (third-party systems) and this repo + the POC (kpk columns); each cell carries its basis.

dimensions.label: Positions declared on-chain, per fund
cells: Global per-chain NAV registry; `account` only filters
Merkle leaves are permissions, not positions
No declaration; NAV is a number

dimensions.label: NAV computed on-chain from positions
cells: Balance adapters read live; assisted/attested caches under-report only
ERC-4626 reads per strategy [UNVERIFIED exact fn]

dimensions.label: Manager permissions per function + arguments
cells: Zodiac Roles v2 scoped functions (DeFi Kit)
Same Roles v2 conditions, generated per position

dimensions.label: Permissions and NAV from one declaration
cells: Roles (DeFi Kit) and NAV registry configured separately
Both derived from FundConfig; FundConfig owns Roles
Same position ids; permission is whole adaptor
Caps and realAssets keyed by the same ids
Strategy set drives caps and accounting

dimensions.label: Manager cannot open an unvalued position
cells: Relies on the out-of-repo Roles allow-list; no tripwire in repo
Every Roles permission comes from a declared, valued position; Safe-owner module changes stay outside
Every allocation routes through a valuing adapter

dimensions.label: Debt and multi-leg positions
cells: Debt works; single Accounting per position forces splits

dimensions.label: One bad position cannot block NAV
cells: Per-adapter gas stipend, fail-open + health flags
POC fundNav reuses adapters but is not hardened

dimensions.label: Shared components immutable or timelocked
cells: Immutable adapters; UUPS NAV behind TimelockController
Type registry mutable by fund-deployer owner

dimensions.label: Per-position portfolio readable on-chain by integrators
cells: getAccountPositions: per-position PositionBalance with protocol identity, kind, debt flag
Same, scoped to the fund's declared positions
Position ids + balanceOf; no protocol identity schema
